gloss: to bend sharply; to be bent (double)

definitions.gloss: to bend sharply; to be bent; to fold
definitions.explanation: Of something straight or flat, to bend at an angle or fold over, often from force or damage; of a road or corridor, to turn at a sharp angle.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{折|お}れ{曲|ま}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The corner of the book's page is folded over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぐにゃり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{折|お}れ{曲|ま}がってしまった。
examples.english: In the accident, the road sign was bent right over.

notes:
⟦{折|お}れる→折れる：01266_oreru⟧ (to break, to fold) plus ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧ (to bend). Stronger than ⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: the thing bends to an angle or folds, as if almost snapped.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive. To bend something sharply yourself is ⟦{折|お}り{曲|ま}げる→折り曲げる：07008_orimageru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{折|お}れ{曲|ま}がる: a corner gets folded over
- {折|お}れ{曲|ま}がった⟦{針金|はりがね}→針金：04324_harigane⟧: a bent piece of wire
